prompt: Wide 2D pixel-art background for a side-scrolling game: one long continuous cut-away cross-section of the ground floor of a medieval stone castle, seen perfectly straight on like a dollhouse with the front wall removed, no perspective, no isometric angle, flat back wall, flat stone floor running straight across the bottom, flat ceiling beam across the top. At the far left end a stone staircase climbs up through the ceiling and at the far right end another stone staircase climbs up through the ceiling and also goes down through the floor. Between them the floor is divided into rooms by three thin stone partition walls evenly spaced, making four rooms of equal width, each with an open arched doorway sized for a person and a wooden door standing open. The rooms are completely empty: bare walls, no furniture, no people. Tall arched windows in the back wall have their glass panes filled with solid flat pure green (#00FF00) like a green screen. Light from the upper left, crisp pixels, cosy 16-bit RPG palette.
